competitors.name: Cape Cod Cafe
competitors.action: Cape Cod Cafe rolled its frozen South Shore bar pizzas into approximately 400 Target stores nationwide, turning a strong regional restaurant-CPG concept into a much broader retail test across the Northeast, Mid-Atlantic, and Southeast.

competitors.name: Rich Products / Great Kitchens
competitors.action: Rich Products said its acquisition of Great Kitchens creates a vertically integrated topped-pizza and flatbread platform spanning deli and frozen, combining crust innovation with private-label take-and-bake and Uno-branded pizza scale.

competitors.name: Dr. Praeger's
competitors.action: Dr. Praeger's launched Pizza Stars nationwide at Target, Whole Foods, and more, pushing pizza flavor into a better-for-you frozen snack format built around cauliflower, zucchini, gluten-free credentials, and kid-friendly shape cues.

trends.topic: The freezer keeps fragmenting into distinct winners instead of one generic premium lane
trends.magnitude: Cape Cod Cafe is scaling a regional restaurant pizza into Target, Rich is consolidating private-label and topped-pizza manufacturing power, and Dr. Praeger's is stretching pizza into a health-forward snack format.
trends.context: For Real Dough, the signal is that premium quality alone is not enough. The brands breaking through either own a very specific regional story, control serious manufacturing/distribution leverage, or translate pizza into a clearer adjacent use case like better-for-you snacking.

market_data.metric: Great Kitchens workforce joining Rich Products

breaking.headline: Three different freezer winners showed up today, regional authenticity, manufacturing scale, and better-for-you format innovation
breaking.impact: Cape Cod Cafe shows a regional restaurant pizza can travel nationally if the story is sharp. Rich shows scale players are still consolidating pizza capability fast. Dr. Praeger's shows pizza-adjacent frozen snacks are stealing attention with health and convenience hooks. Real Dough should keep narrowing its retail story around a distinct pizza identity, not a broad premium claim.
